Package objects

Class Human

java.lang.Object
objects.BaseObject
objects.Human
All Implemented Interfaces:
Attackable, Interactable
Direct Known Subclasses:
Extrovert, Introvert, Player, TA, Teacher
public abstract class Human extends BaseObject implements Interactable, Attackable
Abstract base class for all human characters (NPCs and the player) on the game board. Extends BaseObject and implements Interactable and Attackable. Provides health management, active state tracking, and a facing direction for rendering.
